If you looked right after this change, you'd see a clean, readable warning message in the log instead of a cryptic crash error.

eli5.text: You run a smart assistant that remembers what it was just thinking by caching parts of its conversations. In the live version of the software that runs that cache, a setting that would normally cause the system to write out a detailed journal of every cache lookup is now turned off, so the cache stops leaving those trace logs behind. That switch is flipped only in the production version of the software, the one actually running right now, so you wouldn't see those verbose cache logs in your current session.

ai.title: Fix cache debug emission timing in SDK stream
ai.summary: Moved `emitCacheDebugProviderRequest` call in `sdk/src/impl/llm.ts` from before stream processing to after `response.response` resolution. Prevents premature emission of provider request metadata during active streaming, ensuring cache debug callbacks receive finalized request state. Affects SDK core streaming implementation.

eli5.text: When an assistant replies piece by piece instead of all at once, the system used to announce that a message was being prepared too early, before the reply was fully ready, which meant debugging tools sometimes logged incomplete information. The announcement now waits until the reply is finished, so debugging logs capture the complete, final message. This affects developers who use the SDK's streaming feature to build apps where the assistant responds in real time.

ai.summary: Freebuff CLI now uses simplified `parseArgs` in `cli/src/index.tsx`, removing `--agent`, `--clear-logs`, positional `[prompt...]`, and `--free`/`--max`/`--plan` flags. eli5.text: If you run the free version of the assistant, you can no longer pass a starting prompt or pick a specific agent from the command line - the program now waits for you to type your request in the chat instead of taking it as an argument. This change is live now, not something coming later.

ai.title: base2-free uses direct tools instead of sub-agents
ai.summary: base2-free now invokes code_search, list_directory, and glob directly instead of spawning code-searcher, directory-lister, and glob-matcher sub-agents. This change prevents parallel tool execution issues by restricting free-tier agents to sequential tool calls. The update modifies agents/base2/base2.ts to conditionally include these tools and exclude the corresponding spawnable agents when isFree is true.

eli5.text: When you use the free version of the assistant, it now does simple tasks one at a time (like searching files, listing folders, and finding matching files) instead of splitting them off to specialized helper tools that could run at the same time. This avoids confusion when multiple tools try to work in parallel. If you are on the free tier today, the assistant simply handles these basic chores directly rather than delegating them.
